findings.description: When stripping ANSI, the code also calls `.strip()` on the prompt text, removing leading and trailing whitespace. The commit only intends to remove ANSI codes.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a prompt like 'Name: ' (the usual trailing space, which click adds via prompt_suffix) is passed on a non-color stream such as a piped stdout or CliRunner. The code strips the trailing space, so the prompt shows as 'Name:' directly against the user's input. Leading indentation is dropped as well. Output differs depending on whether the stream supports color.
